weapon.d:
At start of player phase or enemy phase, grants Atk/Def+6 to unit and allies within 3 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit, unit deals +X damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 50% of X during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials; X = highest total bonuses among unit and allies within 3 spaces of unit).

At start of player phase or enemy phase, grants Atk/Def+6 to unit and allies within 3 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit, unit deals +X damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 50% of X during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials; X = highest total bonuses among unit and allies within 3 spaces of unit).

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Def.
Boosts damage by 80% of unit's Def.

a.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ foe's HP+3, grants Def+2 during combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ foe's HP+3, grants Def+4 during combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ foe's HP+3, grants Def+6 during combat.

b.d: If unit's HP ≥ 75% and foe initiates combat, neutralizes bonuses (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) on foe during combat and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit's HP ≥ 50% and foe initiates combat, neutralizes bonuses (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) on foe during combat and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit's HP ≥ 25% and foe initiates combat, neutralizes bonuses (from skills like Fortify, Rally, etc.) on foe during combat and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
